title: Fix Cloudinary product videos in Expo
summary: The Expo player independently passed stored HTML embed URLs to expo-video; normalize these links and add native playback feedback.

changes.detail: Resolve Cloudinary embed pages to video/upload H.264 MP4 before native playback. Keep URL handling inside the mobile project so EAS packaging does not depend on parent source files.

Use native controls, inline web playback, posters until first frame, loading indicator, localized errors and retry with a fresh native player. Pause when leaving the video slide; preserve gallery arrows, counter and image viewer.

validation.name: Inspection
validation.detail: Read SDK 57 documentation and installed expo-video types. Found direct unnormalized uri and unused poster in Expo gallery.

validation.name: Mobile checks and device playback
validation.detail: Checks pending. No EAS update or binary has been published.
